bpmFix.title: Fix BPM Drift
bpmFix.ambiguityHint: Ambiguous beats. Check BPM and multiplier.
bpmFix.lossyHint: Lossy formats such as MP3 / AAC will be re-encoded.
bpmFix.invalidOptions: Check target BPM (30–300) and confirm each low-confidence song.
bpmFix.localBeatWarning: Overall beat checks passed, but {count} detected beats have larger local timing deviations. Listen to confirm the result.
bpmFix.stretchWarning: {count} segments require substantial stretching. Listen to confirm audio quality.
bpmFix.peakAdjusted: Overall gain was reduced to avoid clipping.
bpmFix.busy: A BPM drift repair session already exists. Restore it from the task bar.
bpmFix.outputExists: An audio file already exists at the destination. This song was not published.
bpmFix.lowConfidence: The beats could not be identified reliably. Check the BPM and beat multiplier.
bpmFix.verificationFailed: Could not confirm that the repaired beats align, so no new file was saved and the original is unchanged. Reopen this tool and check the target BPM and beat multiplier before trying again.
bpmFix.extremeStretch: Some segments require excessive stretching. Processing was stopped.
bpmFix.sourceChanged: The original changed during processing. Close and analyze again.
bpmFix.runtimeHint: The analysis components are not ready. Install them and try again.
bpmFix.librosaUnavailable: The beat-checking components are incomplete. Update the analysis components and try again.
bpmFix.rendererUnavailable: Audio processing is unavailable. Repair or reinstall the app.
bpmFix.libraryBusy: Wait until the library merge finishes.
bpmFix.invalidPlaylist: The playlist or song location changed. Reopen the playlist and try again.
bpmFix.unsupportedFormat: Cannot retain this audio format. Choose WAV.
bpmFix.failedHint: Processing failed. Details were logged. Completed outputs are retained.
bpmFix.recoveryRequired: Another application occupied the original filename. The original audio is preserved in a recovery backup. See the log for its location.
